paite: Theigigein, Aw TOUPA, ka tung ua hongtung: a honkouna uh en inla, muin.
english: Remember, Yahweh, what has come on us: Look, and see our reproach.

paite: Ka gouluah uh mikhualte lama heiiin a oma, ka inte uh gamdangmite lamah.
english: Our inheritance is turned to strangers, Our houses to aliens.

paite: Tagah leh pabei ka hi ua, ka nute uh meithaite bang ahi uh.
english: We are orphans and fatherless; Our mothers are as widows.

paite: sum jiakin ka tui uh kadawnkhin ua; ka singte uh kou laka juakin a om hi.
english: We have drunken our water for money; Our wood is sold to us.

paite: A hondelhte ka ngawng jang uah a om ua, ka bah ua, khawlna ka neikei uh.
english: Our pursuers are on our necks: We are weary, and have no rest.

paite: Aiguptate kiang leh, Assuriate kiangah, Tanghoua lungkimna dingin ka kipia uh.
english: We have given the hand to the Egyptians, To the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.

paite: Ka pipute uh a nakhial ua, aom kei uh; a gitlouhna uh kou ka pua uh.
english: Our fathers sinned, and are no more; We have borne their iniquities.

paite: Sikhaten ka tunguah vai a hawm ua: a khut ua kipana kou hon tankhe ding kuamah a om kei uh.
english: Servants rule over us: There is none to deliver us out of their hand.

paite: Ka hinna uh lauthawnna toh ka tanghou uh ka mu ua gamdai namsau jiakin.
english: We get our bread at the peril of our lives, Because of the sword of the wilderness.

paite: Thuk bangin ka vun uh a voma nakpitaka kialna jiakin.
english: Our skin is black like an oven, Because of the burning heat of famine.

paite: Ziona numeite a sual ua, Juda khopitea nungakte.
english: They ravished the women in Zion, The virgins in the cities of Judah.

paite: A khut un lalte khailupin a om ua, upate maite zahtakin a om kei hi.
english: Princes were hanged up by their hand: The faces of elders were not honored.

paite: Tangvalten khawl a pua ua, naupang te singnuaiah a kisui uh.
english: The young men bare the mill; The children stumbled under the wood.

paite: Kongpi akipan upate a khawl ua, a lasakna ua kipanin Tangvalte a khawl uh.
english: The elders have ceased from the gate, The young men from their music.

paite: Ka lungtang kipahna uh a tawpa; ka lamnauh dahna a suak hi.
english: The joy of our heart is ceased; Our dance is turned into mourning.

paite: Ka lu ua kipan ka lallukhu uh a kiaa, ka tung uh a gik hi! ka khelh jiakun.
english: The crown is fallen from our head: Woe to us! for we have sinned.

paite: Hiai jiakin ka lungtang uh a baha; hiai thilte jiakin ka mitte uh a miala;
english: For this our heart is faint; For these things our eyes are dim;

paite: Suksiatna om, Zion mual jiakin; sehalte a tungah a vak uh.
english: For the mountain of Zion, which is desolate: The foxes walk on it.

paite: Aw TOUPA, nang khantawnin na om gige; na laltutphah khang khata kipanin khang khat tanin a om hi.
english: You, Yahweh, remain forever; Your throne is from generation to generation.

paite: Bangdinga khantawna kou honmanngilha, hichi tantan honnungngatsan na hia?
english: Why do you forget us forever, And forsake us so long time?

paite: Nang lam hon ngasakin, Aw TOUPA huchiin bawlhoih nawnin ka om ding uh; nidang lai bangin ka nite uh thaksakin.Ahihkeileh non nialkhe hilhiala hia? Ka tunguah na heh lomahmaha hia?
english: Turn us to yourself, Yahweh, and we shall be turned. Renew our days as of old.

paite: Ahihkeileh non nialkhe hilhiala hia? Ka tunguah na heh lomahmaha hia?
english: But you have utterly rejected us; You are very angry against us.
